assumptions_checked: pace is arithmetic on two fields (available time / demand), not full takt/line-balancing (T-32, v1.1)
only value_add/enabling steps are eligible -- a non_value_add (wait) step is excluded by construction
provenance.method: constraint_step = argmax(step.time_minutes) over PROCESSING steps only (step_type value_add or enabling) -- a pure-wait non_value_add step cannot be the constraint (matrix §5a A-7, fidelity fix); pace_minutes_per_unit = available_time_minutes / demand_units; meets_pace judged on this step

assumptions_checked: no step_type filter -- a pure wait is eligible here even though it can't be the constraint_step
provenance.method: longest_step = argmax(step.time_minutes) over ALL timed steps, any step_type (waits included)

artifact.notes: Swimlane walk of the SIPOC's register-to-handoff segment, first drawn July 21, step times filled in August 3 from the time study's element medians (typical cycle, robust to the flagged July 28 rush outlier -- the sum of element medians, a typical cycle, not the mean total; the eight timed cycles average 8.8): 0.8 + 4.5 + 2.0 + 0.6 + 0.5 = 8.4 minutes -- the charter baseline. Demand block: weekday 7:00-10:00 peak (180 min, the peak window every other artifact in this demo uses); 48 espresso orders per peak (July tally, same count the spaghetti observation logged) -- pace 3.75 min per order. The engine's constraint readout (processing steps only -- value_add/enabling, matrix A-7 fidelity fix) names s3, Prepare drink at espresso station, 2.0 min, as the constraint -- it meets the 3.75 pace; the espresso-station lane carries 2.6 min of processing work across s3 and s4 (2.0 + 0.6). The engine's longest-step readout (any type, waits included) names s2, Cup waits in drink queue, 4.5 min -- honestly exceeding the 3.75 pace, but a pure wait can never be named the constraint: it sits downstream of the constraint, its consequence, not its cause.
